//: Sound effects map. Each entry binds a worldState 'change' event kind (or a synthetic event name) to an audio file. Files are relative to assets/audio/ and must exist for playback to actually fire — missing files are silently skipped (no console spam) so you can ship the system before the audio assets land.

ambient.//: Office background music. Provide EITHER a single looping file via 'loop', OR a rotating playlist via 'playlist' (tracks play in sequence, then repeat forever; set 'shuffle': true to randomize the order each cycle). Files live in assets/audio/ and are silently skipped if absent. Presence-gated: plays only while Alt+V presence is on.

layers.//: Room-air bed — L/R stems played together for a wide stereo field. Swap to the 25/50/75% variants (office-air/left-50.ogg etc.) for a quieter/closer feel.
layers.name: office-air

layers.//: Distant office chatter murmur. Uses the 75% stems; drop to 50% for subtler, 100% for busier.
layers.name: chatter

door.//: Client-triggered via window.DenizenSfx.playEvent('door', 'open'|'close'). Sliding glass street door on the office↔city transition.

footsteps.//: Controllable loop via window.DenizenSfx.setLoop('footsteps', true|false) — office-scene drives it from the player's walk state. Indoor floor; swap to footsteps/hard.ogg or footsteps/grass.ogg for other surfaces.

keyboard.//: Controllable loop via setLoop('keyboard', …). sfx.js auto-drives it while the user types in a text field (chat, etc.); stops ~500ms after typing pauses.

crm_lead.//: Office phone rings when a fresh CRM lead is captured. Fired server-side by worldState.notifyCrmLead → world_state frame; routed here by kind. One-shot.
